scope: Five public SDH APIs with actual legacy section iterator and native-matching range sets; canonical three bool bytes, empty ranges, observer allow/block and SVC success/errors
limitations: Observer handler bodies and SVC replies are fixtures; actual SDK critical/NVIC instructions execute with emulated MMIO.
Typed stack/state observer records are source-owned; unresolved callback bodies and final production allocation remain gates.
No real asynchronous scheduling, flash persistence, original instructions or full-image linkage proof.
